svg.title: The service holds persistent changes
svg.desc: Combine the persistent users, staged plugin, notes and ordinary package traffic in one service view. Retain each state; activity around the plugin must not make it look executed.

**Action:** Several risk signals coexist without yet becoming one human-readable event.

**Caption:**
> THE SYSTEM CONTAINS MORE THAN THE NEXT ALERT WILL SAY.

**Provenance:** `inferred` — dramatic preparation for the narrower 27 June port-sweep alert.
